conditions.hostLoad: Operator reserved this local-SSD workstation for this run without competing work; supported-platform runs are sequential.
conditions.cacheState: OS cache not flushed; clone checksums and migration preparation precede startup.
conditions.workloadInjection: A benchmark-only preload offers at most one controlled outbox fixture per 500ms slot, skipping a slot occupied by an actual incident event. Actual offers and receipts are measured separately; delayed worker timers do not prove two sends/second. Normal delivery, signing, retry and browser code is unchanged.
conditions.hostReservation: Explicit operator confirmation on 2026-10-12; this flag is an operator attestation, not automatic detection of unrelated processes.
conditions.apiMethod: Four sequential read categories inside the 30-minute measurement, each with concurrency five and 1,000 requests. An independent concurrency-five mutation category is paced across all 30 minutes below the unchanged 60/minute limit. Ten browsers and normal monitoring/webhooks remain active throughout.

mutations.method: Actual CRUD/reservation acknowledgments, paced beneath the unchanged 60/minute operator mutation limit in the full reference profile.

webhookLoad.method: Actual reference-load offers and receipts before overload; retries during failing-receiver overload are separate.

transactions.method: Synchronous Store transaction duration for ordinary finish operations inside the actual SQLite worker, selected by actual completion timestamp in the measurement window; delayed telemetry is retained. Excludes IPC, network and queue delay.

browserInteraction.method: Browser performance.now from the captured input/click event to two animation frames; actual content/network loading is recorded separately as loadedMs.

limitations: Explicit experimental beta policy: 400 MiB and a 15-minute observation. Stable performance criteria remain unchanged and separately evaluated.

historyTranslation.method: On the disposable synthetic clone only, exclude closed startup-rehearsal runs after the last modeled observation which have no check references. Preserve all historical runs and observation links, including actual gaps. One common timestamp translation then preserves every observation, duration, ordering, ID, relation and historical coverage interval. Reject any remaining recovery clock beyond the anchor. The original fixture and schema migration metadata are unchanged; normal retention remains enabled.

overload.method: Manual queue pressure uses the actual scheduler domain entry point; HTTP rate-limit pressure is measured separately without bypassing its limit.

storage.backup: NOT TESTED in load run; separate release backup verification remains required.

betaAcceptance.limitations: A 15-minute load observation and 90-second overload do not establish long-term stability, capacity or production suitability. Stable latency, fairness and overload failures remain recorded.
